description.narrative: Overall objective of the project is to strengthen independent media organizations in BiH, by enhancing their capacities in project management, organizational governance, and editorial quality. This capacity building aims to result in more effective, sustainable, transparent, and resilient media operations that can better withstand political pressures and restrictive laws aimed at curbing media freedom and independent journalism. The intervention will ensure comprehensive coverage across Bosnia and Herzegovina by engaging a broad range of media outlets and organizations at both national and regional levels. The project specifically targets key independent media based in BiH which are recognized for their critical voices and significant influence in the country. Support to these outlets includes organizational, managerial, and editorial capacity building to help them adapt to the hostile legislative environment.

Projektets övergripande mål är att stärka oberoende medieorganisationer i Bosnien och Hercegovina genom att förbättra deras kapacitet inom projektledning, organisationsstyrning och redaktionell kvalitet. Denna kapacitetsutveckling syftar till att skapa mer effektiva, hållbara, transparenta och motståndskraftiga medieverksamheter som bättre kan stå emot politiska påtryckningar och restriktiv lagstiftning som syftar till att begränsa mediefriheten och det oberoende journalistiska arbetet.
Insatsen kommer att säkerställa en heltäckande geografisk täckning i hela Bosnien och Hercegovina genom att engagera ett brett spektrum av medieaktörer och organisationer på både nationell och regional nivå. Projektet riktar sig särskilt till centrala oberoende medier baserade i Bosnien och Hercegovina, vilka är välkända för sina kritiska röster och sitt betydande inflytande i landet. Stödet till dessa medieaktörer omfattar kapacitetsutveckling inom organisationsstyrning, ledning och redaktionellt arbete för att hjälpa dem att anpassa sig till den alltmer restriktiva lagstiftningsmiljön.

Overall objective of the project is to strengthen independent media organizations in BiH, by enhancing their capacities in project management, organizational governance, and editorial quality. This capacity building aims to result in more effective, sustainable, transparent, and resilient media operations that can better withstand political pressures and restrictive laws aimed at curbing media freedom and independent journalism.
Intended Outcomes: 1.Enhanced project management and financial oversight within supported media outlets, ensuring effective implementation of activities and compliance with donor requirements. 2.Improved editorial quality and risk management in media production, leading to increased investigative output, innovative storytelling, and journalistic resilience against restrictive environments. 3.Greater visibility and awareness of the challenges faced by media and civil society organizations through in-depth investigative reporting. 4.Strengthened advocacy efforts externally, including legal and policy reforms, improved protection mechanisms for journalists, and international support for media freedom. 5.Increased sustainability of independent media via improved fundraising, operational policies, and stronger institutional frameworks, enabling long-term viability and freedom from undue political or economic influence.
The intervention will ensure comprehensive coverage across Bosnia and Herzegovina by engaging a broad range of media outlets and organizations at both national and regional levels. The project specifically targets key independent media based in BiH which are recognized for their critical voices and significant influence in the country. Support to these outlets includes organizational, managerial, and editorial capacity building to help them adapt to the hostile legislative environment.
